# CASEs with `tags` `philosophy-of-technology`

*Topics — What a work is about. Nucleation holds whatever reading the owner files here, whether or not an Anthology of the SOTA topic could also hold it; instruction for ML practice belongs to the anthology (ADR-048). The words are seeded from the clusters the reading-time triage of 2026-09-25 found, and grow by decision.*

**Philosophy of technology** — what technology is and what it does to those who live with it — the autonomy of technique, technological determinism and the social shaping of technology, lock-in and practical compulsion, automation and deskilling, technical codes and the politics of artifacts, design that steers or captures its users, critical theory of technology and convivial tools. A technology's regulation stays with society-and-governance, a measured effect of one product with social-science and a verdict on what is owed with ethics, unless the work argues about technology as such; how software is built is software-engineering (group: philosophy; ADR-098).

| [CASE-263](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-263.md) | Regressive progress, a stipulated pair: an innovation that raises national output by fifteen per cent while raising economic insecurity, concentrating institutional power and reducing workers' room for independent judgment, and a medical advance that needs complex infrastructure and adds dependence while greatly reducing suffering; a standard of progress is tested by whether it ranks the first below and the second above | A's, from A8 §XII of the exchange "Analyze technological civilization trap" (2026-11-13), "The possibility of regressive progress". Two stipulated innovations pull standards of progress apart: growth ranks the first as progress; a rule that counts added dependence as regression ranks the second as regress. A ranks the first as not decisively progress and the second as "a tremendous advance in human freedom", because it "judges technology by the forms of life and distributions of power it makes possible—not simply by its complexity". [QUESTION-465](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-465.md) asks for a statement of the standard against which some outcome would count; this pair is a test any such statement must pass, and it separates the standard from growth and from anti-dependence. It does not show how the standard weighs a case where its own parts conflict. The wording is A's; adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CASE-277](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-277.md) | Two hospitals, stipulated, with the same AI diagnostic system and equally complete audit trails of the same approval before the same bad outcome: in one the clinician had time, independent information, authority to override and protected escalation; in the other overwhelming volume, too little information and penalties for overriding | From the third review of 2026-11-16 (ChatGPT's, forwarded by the owner), built to separate traceability from fair attribution ([CLAIM-712](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-712.md)).
